body.title: Planner core
body.summary: Add src/workflow/convert/plan.ts and src/workflow/convert/raw-heads.ts: refuse on a merge in progress or uncommitted changes under .insrc/artifacts and docs/epics; read every file raw, list unreadable files as problems; compute the before-snapshot with legacyDeliveryView; return equal plans for the same tree and an empty plan for a converted tree; recompute-and-compare for apply. Test src/workflow/convert/__tests__/convert-preview.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: A merge or dirty tree is refused naming the paths
An unreadable file is a problem in the plan and nothing is skipped silently
Two plans of the same tree are equal and a preview writes nothing

tests.name: convert-preview.test.ts: a preview writes nothing, refuses a dirty tree and lists unreadable files as problems
